initial_scientific_signal: Clinical heterogeneity evolved toward etiologic/pathophysiological classification; 1979 NDDG described diabetes as a heterogeneous syndrome and formalized a new classification.
contextual_signal: International NIH-sponsored workgroup; later classification benefited from insulin physiology, immunology and standardized laboratory diagnosis. Context contribution not yet deeply reconstructed.
key_sources: NDDG 1979 Diabetes doi:10.2337/diab.28.12.1039; NCBI Clinical Methods Diabetes Mellitus

initial_scientific_signal: Crohn, Ginzburg and Oppenheimer described regional ileitis in 1932 as a pathologic and clinical entity resembling but distinguishable from ulcerative colitis; subsequent reports extended anatomic range.
contextual_signal: Mount Sinai surgical/pathology environment in New York; published during the Great Depression. Whether economic context materially delayed or shaped the split remains to be tested rather than assumed.
key_sources: Crohn et al JAMA 1932 doi:10.1001/jama.1932.02740680019005; Bisgard & Henske JAMA 1937

later_classification: Distinct hepatitis A B non-A-non-B/C and later viral hepatitis entities
initial_scientific_signal: Different epidemiology and transmission patterns were followed by virologic/serologic identification of distinct agents.
contextual_signal: World War II outbreaks created direct US military urgency; military investigators helped define two forms of hepatitis and later contributed to virology and vaccine development.
key_sources: Dooley Military Medicine 2005 doi:10.7205/MILMED.170.4S.71; Feinstone hepatitis A history PMC6496330

later_classification: Acute promyelocytic leukemia as a distinct AML subtype
initial_scientific_signal: Distinct morphology and severe coagulopathy preceded cytogenetic t(15;17), PML-RARA mechanism and extraordinary differentiation response to ATRA/ATO.
contextual_signal: Chinese ATO discovery occurred during the Cultural Revolution; traditional Chinese medicine, constrained scientific conditions and later international collaboration affected discovery and recognition. Western pharmaceutical companies initially declined ATRA manufacture according to historical review.
key_sources: Hillestad/APL histories PMC8690702 and PMC7360001; Zhang discovery history PMID 23645104; HKMJ arsenic history

later_classification: HER2-positive and other molecularly defined breast cancer subtypes
initial_scientific_signal: HER2 amplification/overexpression associated with aggressive course; mechanistic targeting with trastuzumab produced subgroup-specific clinical benefit; gene-expression profiling later expanded intrinsic molecular subtypes.
contextual_signal: NCI-supported research, biotechnology capability at Genentech, companion diagnostic development, FDA pathway and patient advocacy all influenced translation and adoption.
key_sources: NCI HER2 discovery history; Genentech HER2 timeline; Perou-era molecular classification reviews

initial_scientific_signal: Clinical heterogeneity was followed by molecular characterization of inflammatory pathways; omics, large cohorts and targeted biologics supported T2-high endotype.
contextual_signal: Availability of transcriptomics/omics, large cohort infrastructure and biologic drug development enabled endotyping; unequal marker/treatment development across endotypes may reflect research and commercial opportunity as well as biology.
key_sources: Lee et al Understanding Asthma Phenotypes Endotypes and Mechanisms PMC6411459; Ray et al Physiological Reviews 2020

initial_scientific_signal: 1996 standardized clinical-course descriptors were based on expert survey and clinical pattern; later revisions added activity/progression modifiers while acknowledging lack of objective biological markers separating phenotypes.
contextual_signal: Explicit motivation included communication, prognostication, trial design and recruitment; National MS Society and international clinical-trial infrastructure were central.
key_sources: Lublin & Reingold Neurology 1996 doi:10.1212/WNL.46.4.907; Lublin et al 2014 PMC4117366

later_classification: Paranoid disorganized catatonic undifferentiated residual subtypes
initial_scientific_signal: Traditional symptom-dominant subtypes persisted for decades but showed limited diagnostic stability, low reliability, poor validity and no distinctive treatment-response or longitudinal-course patterns.
contextual_signal: Long institutional persistence in DSM/ICD despite weakening research use provides a negative control for classification inertia and administrative tradition.
key_sources: APA Highlights DSM-IV-TR to DSM-5; Tandon et al 2013; Braff et al subtype-use review PMC3686462
